says: alice binds her key and founds the Team Platform under a policy needing one independent approval to publish; bob binds his key and is invited, alice verifies his key in person against the invitation, and bob consents naming that verification and is admitted. alice registers a Team knowledge source's home and commits its revision against the head the registration moved to, and a preparation for her work comes back with its required body absent. She registers the Team's decisions source and proposes a publication into it, which waits for review. Four things are then refused, each through the visible control and again by direct submission. (1) Review-only save: in the W05 review of her proposed publication, focusing Save and pressing Enter only shows a blocker, selects nothing and dispatches nothing; a route.select naming the save route as focused but not selected is refused at admission (missing_field /selected). (2) A body cleared by navigation: W08 shows the preparation's missing body, and going to W01 and back keeps the same missing-body set; a route.select claiming that the back route delivered it is refused with navigation_changed_state. (3) A stale approval: alice changes the policy while the publication waits; bob's W05 shows the proposal as stale and the approve control blocked, and Enter dispatches nothing; his team.approval.record under the replaced policy version is refused as policy_superseded, its way back a new governed request. (4) A closed Team's revival: after alice closes the Team, W07 reads its state and shows the Team as closed, and the reopen control only shows a blocker; team.lifecycle.apply restore is refused with team_terminal. None of the four is saved, cleared, approved or reopened by either path.
